messages:
Sophia (Partnerships): FYI partner just sent a firmware recall affecting 3 racks in eu-west-1 and us-west-2 :warning: we have reservations tied to Dedicated customers. Need options for capacity continuity ASAP.
Mike (Supply Ops): Copy. Affected reservations: 
```
resv-9821-eu
resv-9822-us
resv-9823-eu
```
ETA on corrected firmware from partner is ~14 business days. Shipping holds until then.
Raj (Cloud Sales): Oof. Short-term we can route affected customers to Hosted API (self-serve) or move them to marketplace SKUs if they accept footprint/price variance. Marketplace listing has available on-demand capacity in both regions.
Val (Infra Ops): We can spin up temporary Dedicated on other racks if we can reassign GPU entitlements. That needs 24-48h ops work and license toggle from partner. Also need to verify KV cache warmup for canaries.
Emma (Customer Success): Who owns customer comms? We need a plain english note and an ETA. Some accounts are on reserved contracts, can't just swap without approval.
Oliver (Legal): Any contractual impact? If we tip into SLA credits, we need to trigger the incidents flow. Also if we reallocate reserved units, we need an amendment for finance signoff.
inventory-bot: Affected serials: S/N 44-11-8A, 44-11-8B, 44-11-8C. Current state: "hold - firmware". Next update 2026-03-25.
Mike (Supply Ops): Proposed plan (quick):
1) Short-term (0-72h): Move 2 lower-priority reserved customers to Hosted API routes with discounted marketplace credits (we cover delta). Move one critical customer to spare rack pool we control.
2) Mid-term (3-14d): Partner patches and ships; we return customers and reconcile billing via one-off credit notes.
3) Communication: CS draft + legal approve. Ops to confirm technical switch.
Sophia (Partnerships): That sounds reasonable. Need signoff: @Oliver confirm legal ok, @Emma draft comms, @Val can ops do the switch in 24h? Mike pls confirm which customers are the low-priority ones.
Val (Infra Ops): Can do 24h if build queues clear. Need reservation IDs and target racks. Also need partner to push license toggle.
Mike (Supply Ops): Low-priority = acct-neo, acct-aurora. Critical = acct-hyper. I'll DM finance for credit coverage.
Oliver (Legal): Fine with temporary route/swap, legal wants the one-line amendment template. I'll push the template now and loop in finance. No blocker but require written customer acknowledgement for the critical account move.
Emma (Customer Success): I'll draft two comms: one for reserved customers (more formal) and one for users on hosted fallback (short status). ETA for drafts: 2 hours.
Sophia (Partnerships): Great. Action items: Mike = lock target racks + list reservation mappings, Val = prep infra switchbook + test canary, Emma = comms, Oliver = amendment template, Raj = confirm marketplace SKUs & pricing delta. Meeting in 1h to confirm. If anyone can't meet, post updates here. :white_check_mark:
Raj (Cloud Sales): Confirmed SKU availability and price delta ~ +12% for on-demand marketplace. Will share SKU IDs in thread.
Mike (Supply Ops): Locking racks now, I'll post mapping in 15m.
Val (Infra Ops): I'll run a dry-run canary in staging and post results here.
Sophia (Partnerships): thanks everyone. If partner pushes earlier than 14d we'll revert with zero downtime plan.
